chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Pay on the boat jobs and no white hotels in St. Louis
summary: Trent gets $70 when others got $35; they play mostly for whites yet cannot get into white hotels.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: he worked with--Sammy Lewis--that was before that. So in St. Louis--those boats didn't pay that much money, the boat jobs?
He got a nice little piece. I mean, from what the other bands were getting.
Obviously he got more than the other bands. At that time they were getting about thirty-five bucks a week.
Tricks would have got seventy, which was a lot of money.
For them, yes. You're playing for white most of the time. A good job though, a very nice job.
You had no opportunity to get into any of the white hotels in St. Louis?
